description: Write or update one client's brand profile. Every field is optional and only what you pass is changed, so this is safe to call repeatedly to correct a website draft. Pass confirm: true when the answers are right, which is what run_may needs. Confirming needs company_name, domain, flagship_product, offer_landing_page, target_customers and both colors. Needs the May plan and a Mako customer connection.

avoid_claims.description: Claims the creative must never make.

color_navy.description: Primary brand color as hex, for example #1E3A8A.

confirm.description: Set true to mark the profile ready for runs.

daily_budget.description: Default daily budget in whole dollars.

image_notes.description: Art direction for the generated images.

objective.description: The default campaign goal for this client.

offer.description: The standing offer, for example 20% off the variety pack.

offer_landing_page.description: Where the ads should send people.

phone_number.description: Only used by a calls campaign.

proof_points.description: Facts the copy is allowed to claim. Nothing outside this list is used.

signature_claim.description: The one thing this brand is known for.

target_customers.description: Who buys it. One per entry.

voice.description: How the brand sounds, in a sentence or two.

name: set_brand_profile
